node.title: Re^6: regex syntax and idomatic Perl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
So ... $_ in the for loop, and $y are references

Not exactly, $_ is an alias to the elements being looped over, not a reference (which would need to be dereferenced), see the first few paragraphs of [doc://perlsyn#Foreach-Loops]. Some more fun with aliases, note how the magic [doc://substr] lvalue remembers its bounds in the string:

our ($x,$y) = "Hello, World!"; *y = \substr $x, 7, 5; # alias via glob $y = "substring"; print "<$x>\n"; # prints $y = "Perl"; print "<$x>\n"; # prints $x = "Magic, cool stuff!"; print "<$y>\n"; # prints
